//: c8 config for `npm run coverage:cli` — turns the raw NODE_V8_COVERAGE dumps the
CLI integration tests collect from real `cli/dist/index.js` processes into lcov
mapped back onto cli/**/*.ts (the bundle is built with --sourcemap).
Kept in its own file ON PURPOSE: with no --config, c8 silently picks up .nycrc.json
(the e2e/nyc config, which EXCLUDES cli/**) and reports nothing.
include is `**/cli/**` rather than `cli/**` because, when Node caches the source
map, v8-to-istanbul checks exclude-after-remap against `file://` URLs; a root-
anchored pattern never matches those, no ranges get applied, and every file is
reported as a bogus 100%. The `**/` prefix matches both the URL and the real path.
No `all`: c8 counts PHYSICAL lines (blank, comment and data-literal lines included),
so an `all` empty report for a file the CLI never loads (e.g. cli/demo/*.ts, pure
sample data that jest covers fully) would add thousands of 0-hit lines and drag a
100%-covered file down to ~4% once Codecov unions the flags. Files the CLI bundle
never executes simply do not appear in this report; jest's unit flag covers them.
